_comment: Source-scanning patterns as DATA, not literals in gate source. A detector that carries its own patterns inline necessarily matches its own file: g-coverage-single-impl reported itself as a second definition of verdictOf, and g-workspace-hygiene reported itself as importing a .json. Holding the patterns here means no gate contains the text it looks for, so the scan needs no self-exemption — an exemption list is the tampering shape this repo removes.
